title: strip_did_sig_header leaves folded continuation lines
description: crates/reader/src/post/did_verify.rs: strip_did_sig_header (line 326) splits on bare '\n' and removes only lines whose lowercased form starts with 'x-usenet-ipfs-did-sig:'. Per RFC 5322 §2.2.3, header folding means a continuation line begins with SP or HTAB and is logically part of the preceding header. If the X-Usenet-IPFS-DID-Sig header is folded, strip_did_sig_header removes only the first line and leaves the continuation line(s) in the output. The bytes passed to verify_strict then differ from what the author originally signed (which contained no DID-Sig header), causing valid folded-header signatures to fail verification. Correct behavior: after identifying the start line of the DID-Sig header, also remove all immediately following lines that begin with SP or HTAB.
